privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information Shany Living Furniture collects when you browse the site, configure a sofa or place an order, and how that information is used.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Shany Living Furniture, Herzl 34, Tel Aviv, Israel. Company registration number [to be completed]. For any privacy question, write to info@shanyliving.com.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Contact details you enter at checkout or in a consultation request (name, email, phone, delivery address); the sofa configuration you build; order and payment status; and basic technical data such as your language preference and the pages you visit.

sections.heading: Why we use it
sections.body: To prepare quotes, produce and deliver your order, provide advisor support over WhatsApp or phone, and keep records required by Israeli tax and consumer law.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
sections.body: Delivery contractors, our production workshop, and the payment provider handling your transaction. We do not sell personal information, and we do not share it for advertising without your consent.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Under the Israeli Protection of Privacy Law you may ask to see the personal information we hold about you, correct it, or ask us to delete it where we are not required to keep it. Send the request to info@shanyliving.com and we will respond within a reasonable period.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: The site stores your language choice and cart contents in your browser. These are required for the site to work and are not used to track you across other sites.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: These terms apply to the Shany Living site and to made-to-order furniture purchased through it.

sections.heading: Made-to-order products
sections.body: Sofas are produced to the size, configuration, fabric and colour you select. Because each piece is made for you, the specification is confirmed with an advisor before production begins.

sections.heading: Prices and quotes
sections.body: Prices shown are in new Israeli shekels and include VAT unless stated otherwise. Items marked price on request are quoted individually, and a written quote is valid for the period stated on it.

sections.heading: Orders and payment
sections.body: An order is created when you submit your details on the site. Payment is arranged with your advisor by secure payment link, bank transfer or by phone. Production is scheduled after payment terms are agreed.

sections.heading: Delivery and assembly
sections.body: Estimated production and delivery times are given at the time of order and confirmed by your advisor. Delivery includes placement in the room of your choice and assembly where required.

sections.heading: Cancellation and returns
sections.body: Consumer cancellation rights under Israeli law apply, with the exception for goods manufactured specially for the customer. Your advisor will explain what applies to your specific order before production starts.

sections.heading: Warranty
sections.body: Frames and workmanship are covered against manufacturing defects for the period stated on your order confirmation. Normal wear, misuse and unapproved alterations are not covered.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: Shany Living wants the site and the showroom to be usable by everyone, including people using assistive technology.

sections.heading: What we have done
sections.body: The site is built with semantic headings and landmarks, keyboard focus styles, text alternatives for images, colour contrast checked in both light and dark themes, and layouts that reflow down to small screens without horizontal scrolling.

sections.heading: Standard we aim for
sections.body: We work towards the Israeli standard SI 5568, which is based on WCAG 2.0 level AA. Some areas are still being improved, in particular third-party embedded content such as the map.

sections.heading: The showroom
sections.body: Our Herzl 34 showroom is at street level. Call 03-1234567 before your visit and the team will arrange assistance and a quiet time slot if that helps.

sections.heading: Accessibility coordinator
sections.body: Contact [name to be completed] at info@shanyliving.com or 03-1234567 with any accessibility problem you hit on the site. Tell us the page and what happened, and we will respond and fix what we can.

sections.heading: Reporting a problem
sections.body: If something on this site blocks you, we treat it as a defect. Report it and we will give you the information or complete the task with you by phone or WhatsApp in the meantime.
